title: A simple guide to the use of Student's t-test, Mann-Whitney U test, Chi-squared test, and Kruskal-Wallis test in biostatistics
teaching_implication: Start with outcome type and design
limitation: Does not cover all statistical study designs

title: Guidelines for repeated measures statistical analysis approaches with basic science research considerations
teaching_implication: Use correlation-aware analysis for repeated observations
limitation: Specific covariance and dropout assumptions need study review

title: An evaluation of RNA-seq differential analysis methods
limitation: Benchmarks do not guarantee superiority on other data

title: The R Language: An Engine for Bioinformatics and Data Science
teaching_implication: Use R for analysis and reproducible scientific workflows
limitation: Overview does not validate a particular code release

title: The targets R package: a dynamic Make-like function-oriented pipeline toolkit for reproducibility and high-performance computing
teaching_implication: Use dependency graphs and repeatable targets
limitation: Pipeline completion is not proof of scientific validity

title: rworkflows: automating reproducible practices for the R community
teaching_implication: Automate coding checks and package workflow
limitation: Automated checks do not authorize clinical deployment

title: TRIPOD+AI statement: updated guidance for reporting clinical prediction models that use regression or machine learning methods
limitation: Reporting checklist cannot validate a prediction model

title: CONSORT 2025 statement: updated guideline for reporting randomised trials
teaching_implication: Report randomized trial design and results transparently
limitation: Trial reporting guide is not method selection sign-off

title: Best practice in statistics: Use the Welch t-test when testing the difference between two groups
teaching_implication: Consider Welch for unequal-variance independent group means
limitation: Does not address repeated measurements or confounding

title: An Updated Guide to Robust Statistical Methods in Neuroscience
teaching_implication: Consider robust comparisons and effect sizes under heteroscedasticity
limitation: Robust inference needs justified unit and estimand

title: Testing for normality in regression models: mistakes abound (but may not matter)
teaching_implication: Check residual relevance and avoid raw-column Shapiro gating
limitation: Simulation conclusions do not replace study diagnostics

title: Comprehensive guidelines for appropriate statistical analysis methods in research
teaching_implication: Classify outcome, design, hypotheses and assumptions before selecting a test
limitation: A selection framework is not a substitute for design-specific diagnostics

title: Methodological and Statistical Considerations for Cross-Sectional, Case-Control, and Cohort Studies
teaching_implication: Route observational comparisons by outcome and relationship; check selection bias and confounding
limitation: General flow diagrams omit specialized hierarchical and causal identification

title: Analysing matched continuous longitudinal data: A review
teaching_implication: Preserve matched IDs and repeated structure; distinguish paired tests from mixed longitudinal models
limitation: Matched longitudinal settings are not solved by a single generic paired t-test

title: Multiple Imputation for Longitudinal Data: A Tutorial
teaching_implication: Assess missingness mechanism and time structure; consider design-consistent multiple imputation
limitation: Imputation is not automatic and may be biased under unexamined missingness mechanisms

title: Guidelines for a structured manuscript: Statistical methods and reporting in biomedical research journals
teaching_implication: Report estimand, denominators, uncertainty, assumptions, primary outcomes and sensitivity analysis
limitation: Reporting guidance does not certify the validity of a chosen model

title: Effect Estimates, Effect Sizes, Confidence Intervals, and P-values: A Framework for Reporting and Interpreting Biomedical Research
teaching_implication: Present effect estimate, magnitude, confidence interval and p-value without conflation
limitation: A pedagogical framework is not clinical validation or universal effect-size guidance

title: A comparison of statistical methods for modeling count data with an application to hospital length of stay
teaching_implication: Check dispersion and excess zeros before selecting Poisson, NB or zero-inflated models
limitation: Simulation conditions and hospital LOS data do not generalize to every count process

title: The proper application of logistic regression model in complex survey data: a systematic review
teaching_implication: Use design variables, weights, clusters and appropriate variance estimation for survey regression
limitation: Review of DHS/MICS literature does not substitute for each survey's design manual
